responsibility: This target header defines the PRU port’s static machine configuration and preprocessor interface. It sets ABI-facing driver, preprocessor, linker, and startup specs; data-layout properties; register-file numbering, fixed/call-used masks, register names and overlaps; assembly-output conventions and sections; architectural capability macros; and hooks such as REGISTER_TARGET_PRAGMAS, providing the compile-time target macros that shape how GCC models PRU hardware and toolchain conventions.
same_name_distinction: Configuration header for the PRU port: unlike pru.cc, which implements hook logic, pru.md, which describes RTL insn patterns, and pru.opt, which declares command-line switches, this file supplies compile-time target definitions and ABI/toolchain macros such as register layout, data model, assembler conventions, and driver/linker specs.
